newsitem.title: UK: Siebe, GKN down on BZW downgrade.
newsitem.headline: Siebe, GKN down on BZW downgrade.

text.p: Shares in engineering stocks GKN Plc and Siebe Plc fell on Monday after BZW cut profit forcasts for the engineering sector because of sterling's stength and issued a "neutral" rating on the sector, dealers said.
By 1212 GMT, Siebe was down 11p at 10.165 stg while GKN shares were 13p weaker at 984.
"BZW have gone neutral on the engineering sector and are slam-dunking stocks like Siebe and GKN," one market-maker said.

BZW said it was downgrading profit forecasts for the engineering sector by an average of two percent, following a three percent downgrade in December, because of the impact of sterling's continued appreciation.
British Steel was not included in these downgrades as BZW separately cut its forecasts last week.
"With 70 percent of sales overseas, the engineering and engineering vehicle sectors are more exposed than most to currency fluctuations," BZW said in a research note.

"In spite of this second batch of downgrades, the sector has held up well over the last month, which raises some concern about the short-term outlook for the sector and dampens hopes of the usual sector rally in this first quarter," it said.
Market sources said Merrill Lynch had downgraded Siebe to near-term neutral from accumulate on Friday.
